name: builtin-off-topic-is-clean
description: The shipped off_topic@1 template (SPEC §2.8) passes the hard rules and fires no lint; built-ins must stay lint-clean in CI.

question.instructions: Which description best fits the subject of `assistant_response`, judged against `user_request` and the product scope in `rules.allowed_scope`?

on_topic_in_scope.what: Addresses the subject of `user_request`, and that subject is inside `rules.allowed_scope`

answers_outside_scope.what: Addresses `user_request`, but the subject is outside `rules.allowed_scope`

drifts_to_other_subject.what: Talks mainly about a subject `user_request` did not ask about

no_subject_matter.what: Greeting, refusal, or clarifying question with no subject matter
